question: Is a burger a sandwich?
scope: A burger served in a bun. Use ordinary food names; compare constructions and naming conventions without assuming one universal sandwich definition.

turns.text: A burger is a sandwich. You eat it by hand, with bread around the filling.

claims.hint: Name a food you hold that is not a sandwich.

rejected.reason: That is already a sandwich. Name a different handheld food.

claims.hint: Name another food with filling inside bread.

turns.text: Sandwiches use bread slices. Burgers use buns.

claims.hint: Name a sandwich made without two bread slices.

rejected.reason: That usually uses separate bread slices. Try a roll, wrap, or another construction.

claims.hint: Name a sandwich served in a bun or roll.

turns.text: Bread wrapped around a filling? That makes it a sandwich. Shape does not matter.

claims.hint: Name a filled bread food that is not a sandwich.
Name a food you recognize by its shape.

turns.text: Sandwiches are cold lunch food. Burgers are hot meals.

claims.hint: Name a sandwich eaten at another time.

turns.text: Burgers have the same ingredients as sandwiches: bread, meat, cheese and sauce.

claims.hint: Name a different food with similar ingredients.
Name another food made with these ingredients.

turns.text: Burgers have their own menu section and special name. That makes them different from sandwiches.

claims.hint: Name a sandwich with its own menu section.
Name a sandwich with its own name.
